items.source: Will ask the parent factory if the bean cannot be found in this factory instance.
items.translation: 如果在此工厂实例中找不到该 Bean，将向父工厂询问。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: Translates aliases back to the corresponding canonical bean name.
items.translation: 将别名还原为对应的标准 Bean 名称。

items.source: name - the name of the bean to query
items.translation: name - 要查询的 Bean 的名称

items.source:
Return a provider for the specified bean, allowing for lazy on-demand retrieval
of instances, including availability and uniqueness options.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的提供者，支持按需懒加载获取实例，包括可用性和唯一性选项。

items.source: requiredType - type the bean must match; can be an interface or superclass
items.translation: requiredType - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型；可以是接口或父类

items.source: annotationType - the type of annotation to look for (at class, interface or factory method level of the specified bean)
items.translation: annotationType - 要查找的注解类型（在指定 Bean 的类、接口或工厂方法级别）

items.source: a corresponding provider handle
items.translation: 相应的提供者句柄

items.source: NOTE: This method introspects top-level beans only. It does not check nested beans which might match the specified type as well.
items.translation: 注意：此方法仅检查顶层 Bean。 它不会检查可能匹配指定类型的嵌套 Bean。

items.source: Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in. Use BeanFactoryUtils' beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors to include beans in ancestor factories too.
items.translation: 不考虑此工厂可能参与的任意层次结构。请使用 `BeanFactoryUtils` 的 `beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors` 方法，以包含祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source: Bean names returned by this method should always return bean names in the order of definition in the backend configuration, as far as possible.
items.translation: 此方法返回的 Bean 名称应始终尽可能按照后端配置中的定义顺序返回。

items.source: Find an Annotation of annotationType on the specified bean, traversing its interfaces and superclasses if no annotation can be found on the given class itself, as well as checking the bean's factory method (if any).
items.translation: 在指定的 Bean 上查找 `Annotation` 类型的 `annotationType`，如果在该类本身找不到注解，则遍历其接口和父类，同时检查 Bean 的工厂方法（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of beans matching the given type (including subclasses), judging from either bean definitions or the value of getObjectType in the case of FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 返回与给定类型（包括子类）匹配的 Bean 名称，判断依据是 Bean 定义或 FactoryBean 的getObjectType方法的返回值。

items.source: Return an instance, which may be shared or independent, of the specified bean.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的实例，该实例可能是共享的或独立的。

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: BeansException - if a bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建 Bean

items.source:
the names of beans (or objects created by FactoryBeans) matching
the given object type (including subclasses), or an empty array if none
items.translation: 匹配给定对象类型（包括子类）的 Bean 名称（或由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象），如果没有则返回空数组。

items.source: This method goes into ListableBeanFactory by-type lookup territory but may also be translated into a conventional by-name lookup based on the name of the given type. For more extensive retrieval operations across sets of beans, use ListableBeanFactory and/or BeanFactoryUtils.
items.translation: 此方法进入 `ListableBeanFactory` 按类型查找的范围，但也可能根据给定类型的名称转换为常规的按名称查找。对于跨越一组 Bean 的更广泛的检索操作，请使用 `ListableBeanFactory` 和/或 `BeanFactoryUtils`。

items.source: Consider ListableBeanFactory.getBeanNamesForType(Class) with selective BeanFactory.getBean(String) calls for specific bean names in preference to this Map-based retrieval method. Aside from lazy instantiation benefits, this also avoids any exception suppression.
items.translation: 考虑使用ListableBeanFactory.getBeanNamesForType(Class)配合针对特定 bean 名称的选择性BeanFactory.getBean(String)调用，而非这种基于 Map 的检索方法。 除了延迟实例化的优势外，这还可以避免任何异常抑制。

items.source:
Note: Listeners get initialized after the MessageSource, to be able
to access it within listener implementations. Thus, MessageSource
implementations cannot publish events.
items.translation: 注意：监听器在 MessageSource 之后初始化，以便能够在监听器实现中访问它。因此，MessageSource 实现无法发布事件。

items.source:
Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in,
and ignores any singleton beans that have been registered by
other means than bean definitions.
items.translation: 该工厂不考虑其可能参与的任意层次结构，并且会忽略通过除 Bean 定义以外的其他方式注册的任意单例 Bean。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans, which means that FactoryBeans
will get initialized. If the object created by the FactoryBean doesn't match,
the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the type.
items.translation: 是否考虑由 FactoryBean 创建的实例，这意味着 FactoryBean 将被初始化。如果由 FactoryBean 创建的实例不匹配类型，则原始 FactoryBean 本身将与该类型进行匹配。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans if the "allowEagerInit" flag is set,
which means that FactoryBeans will get initialized. If the object created by the
FactoryBean doesn't match, the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the
type. If "allowEagerInit" is not set, only raw FactoryBeans will be checked
(which doesn't require initialization of each FactoryBean).
items.translation: 如果设置了"allowEagerInit"标志，则考虑由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象，这意味着 FactoryBeans 将被初始化。如果 FactoryBean 创建的对象不匹配，则将直接对 FactoryBean 本身进行类型匹配。如果未设置"allowEagerInit"，则仅检查原始的 FactoryBeans（这不需要初始化每个 FactoryBean）。

items.source: Reset Spring's common reflection metadata caches, in particular the ReflectionUtils, AnnotationUtils, ResolvableType and CachedIntrospectionResults caches.
items.translation: 重置 Spring 的通用反射元数据缓存，特别是 `ReflectionUtils`、`AnnotationUtils`、`ResolvableType` 和 `CachedIntrospectionResults` 的缓存。

items.source: Pause all beans in this application context if necessary, and subsequently restart all auto-startup beans, effectively restoring the lifecycle state after ConfigurableApplicationContext.refresh() (typically after a preceding ConfigurableApplicationContext.pause() call when a full Lifecycle.start() of even lazy-starting beans is to be avoided).
items.translation: 如有必要，暂停此应用上下文中的所有 Bean，随后重新启动所有自动启动的 Bean，从而在调用ConfigurableApplicationContext.refresh()后（通常在先前的ConfigurableApplicationContext.pause()调用之后，以避免对包括懒启动 Bean在内的所有 Bean 执行完整的Lifecycle.start()）恢复生命周期状态。

items.source: Stop all beans in this application context unless they explicitly opt out of pausing through SmartLifecycle.isPauseable() returning false.
items.translation: 除非通过 `SmartLifecycle.isPauseable()` 返回 `false` 明确选择暂停，否则停止此应用上下文中的所有 Bean。

items.source: Finish the refresh of this context, invoking the LifecycleProcessor's onRefresh() method and publishing the ContextRefreshedEvent.
items.translation: 完成此上下文的刷新，调用 `LifecycleProcessor` 的 `onRefresh()` 方法并发布 `ContextRefreshedEvent`。

items.source: Return the ApplicationStartup for this application context.
items.translation: 返回此应用上下文的ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Publish the given event to all listeners.
items.translation: 向所有监听器发布给定事件。

items.source: event - the event to publish (may be an ApplicationEvent or a payload object to be turned into a PayloadApplicationEvent)
items.translation: event - 要发布的事件（可以是 ApplicationEvent，或是要转换为 PayloadApplicationEvent 的负载对象）

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether to introspect lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans - or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference - for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references. Only actually necessary initialization for type checking purposes will be performed; constructor and method invocations will still be avoided as far as possible.
items.translation: allowEagerInit - 是否要检查懒加载单例和由 FactoryBeans 创建的 Bean（或由带有"factory-bean"引用的工厂方法创建的 Bean）的类型。请注意，FactoryBeans 需要被急切初始化以确定其类型：因此，请留意将此标志设置为"true"将初始化 FactoryBeans 和"factory-bean"引用。仅会执行实际必要的初始化以用于类型检查目的；仍会尽可能避免调用构造函数和方法。

items.source: allowFactoryBeanInit - whether a FactoryBean may get initialized just for the purpose of determining its object type
items.translation: allowFactoryBeanInit - 是否允许仅为了确定其对象类型而初始化 FactoryBean

items.source: name - the name of the bean to retrieve
items.translation: name - 要检索的 Bean 的名称

items.source: includeNonSingletons - whether to include prototype or scoped beans too or just singletons (also applies to FactoryBeans)
items.translation: includeNonSingletons - 是否包含原型或作用域 Bean，还是仅包含单例（同样适用于 FactoryBean）

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to look for annotations on
items.translation: beanName - 要查找注解的 Bean 的名称

items.source: locale - the locale in which to do the lookup
items.translation: locale - 执行查找的本地化环境

items.source:
a Map with the matching beans, containing the bean names as
keys and the corresponding bean instances as values
items.translation: 一个包含匹配 Bean 的 Map，其中键为 Bean 名称，值为相应的 Bean 实例。

items.source: Default value is determined by createEnvironment(). Replacing the default with this method is one option but configuration through getEnvironment() should also be considered. In either case, such modifications should be performed before refresh().
items.translation: 默认值由createEnvironment()确定。使用此方法替换默认值是其中一种选项，但也应考虑通过getEnvironment()进行配置。无论哪种情况，此类修改都应在执行refresh()之前完成。

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). This may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean (see BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)).
items.translation: 对于 `FactoryBean`，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由 `FactoryBean.getObjectType()` 所暴露。这可能导致先前未初始化的 `FactoryBean` 被初始化（参见 `BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)`）。

items.source: In contrast to a plain BeanFactory, an ApplicationContext is supposed to detect special beans defined in its internal bean factory: Therefore, this class automatically registers BeanFactoryPostProcessors, BeanPostProcessors, and ApplicationListeners which are defined as beans in the context.
items.translation: 与普通的 BeanFactory 相比，ApplicationContext 旨在检测其内部 bean factory 中定义的特殊 bean：因此，该类会自动注册在上下文中作为 bean 定义的BeanFactoryPostProcessors、BeanPostProcessors以及ApplicationListeners。

items.source: A MessageSource may also be supplied as a bean in the context, with the name "messageSource"; otherwise, message resolution is delegated to the parent context. Furthermore, a multicaster for application events can be supplied as an "applicationEventMulticaster" bean of type ApplicationEventMulticaster in the context; otherwise, a default multicaster of type SimpleApplicationEventMulticaster will be used.
items.translation: `MessageSource` 接口也可作为名为 "messageSource" 的 Bean 提供到上下文中；否则，消息解析将委托给父上下文。此外，还可以向上下文提供一个类型为 ApplicationEventMulticaster 的应用事件多播器 Bean，名为 "applicationEventMulticaster"；否则，将使用类型为 SimpleApplicationEventMulticaster 的默认多播器。

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). Depending on the allowFactoryBeanInit flag, this may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean if no early type information is available.
items.translation: 对于FactoryBean，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由FactoryBean.getObjectType()所暴露。根据allowFactoryBeanInit标志，如果无法获取早期类型信息，这可能导致初始化一个先前未初始化的FactoryBean。

items.source: The parent environment is merged with this (child) application context environment if the parent is non-null and its environment is an instance of ConfigurableEnvironment.
items.translation: 父environment与（子）应用程序上下文 environment 进行merged，条件是父对象非null且其 environment 是 ConfigurableEnvironment 的实例。

items.source: Implements resource loading by extending DefaultResourceLoader. Consequently treats non-URL resource paths as class path resources (supporting full class path resource names that include the package path, for example, "mypackage/myresource.dat"), unless the DefaultResourceLoader.getResourceByPath(String) method is overridden in a subclass.
items.translation: 通过扩展DefaultResourceLoader来实现资源加载。因此，除非在子类中重写了DefaultResourceLoader.getResourceByPath(String)方法，否则将非 URL 资源路径视为类路径资源（支持包含包路径的完整类路径资源名称，例如"mypackage/myresource.dat"）。

items.source: Called at the end of doClose()'s shutdown procedure, after this context's BeanFactory has been closed. If custom shutdown logic needs to execute while the BeanFactory is still active, override the destroyBeans() method instead.
items.translation: 在 `doClose()` 的关闭过程结束时调用，此时该上下文的 BeanFactory 已经被关闭。如果需要在 BeanFactory 仍然处于活动状态时执行自定义的关闭逻辑，请覆盖 `destroyBeans()` 方法。

items.source: The default implementation checks the 'active' status of this context overall. May be overridden for more specific checks, or for a no-op if getBeanFactory() itself throws an exception in such a case.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查此上下文的整体'active'状态。可以重写它以进行更具体的检查，或者在getBeanFactory()本身在此类情况下抛出异常时执行空操作。

items.source: Behaves the same as BeanFactory.getBean(String), but provides a measure of type safety by throwing a BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException if the bean is not of the required type. This means that ClassCastException can't be thrown on casting the result correctly, as can happen with BeanFactory.getBean(String).
items.translation: 行为与BeanFactory.getBean(String)相同，但通过在不满足所需类型时抛出 BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException 来提供一定程度的类型安全性。这意味着在正确转换结果时不会抛出 ClassCastException，而使用BeanFactory.getBean(String)则可能发生此类情况。

items.source: Also, generics matching is strict here, as per the Java assignment rules. For lenient fallback matching with unchecked semantics (similar to the 'unchecked' Java compiler warning), consider calling BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) with the raw type as a second step if no full generic match is available with this variant.
items.translation: 此外，这里的泛型匹配是严格的，遵循 Java 赋值规则。 对于宽松的回退匹配（具有 unchecked 语义，类似于 'unchecked'Java 编译器警告），如果此变体没有available，则可以将原始类型作为第二步传递给 BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class)。

items.source: This is a variant of BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType) with a captured generic type for type-safe retrieval, typically used inline: getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {}) - and effectively equivalent to getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...)).
items.translation: 这是 `BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)` 的一个变体，具有捕获的泛型类型以实现类型安全检索，通常用于内联：`getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {})` - 并且实质上等同于 `getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...))`。

items.source: If a bean definition or singleton instance matching the given name is found, this method will return true whether the named bean definition is concrete or abstract, lazy or eager, in scope or not. Therefore, note that a true return value from this method does not necessarily indicate that BeanFactory.getBean(String) will be able to obtain an instance for the same name.
items.translation: 如果找到与给定名称匹配的 Bean 定义或单例实例，无论该命名 Bean 定义是具体的还是抽象的、懒加载的还是非懒加载的、是否在作用域内，此方法都将返回 `true`。因此，请注意，从此方法返回 `true` 并不一定表示 BeanFactory.getBean(String) 能够获取相同名称的实例。

items.source: Note: This does not indicate whether context shutdown has completed. Use ConfigurableApplicationContext.isActive() for differentiating between those scenarios: a context becomes inactive once it has been fully shut down and the original close() call has returned.
items.translation: 注意：这并不表示上下文关闭是否已完成。请使用ConfigurableApplicationContext.isActive()来区分这些场景：一旦上下文完全关闭且原始的close()调用返回后，该上下文即变为非活动状态。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate independent instances. It indicates non-singleton instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) operation to explicitly check for independent instances.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不能明确表示独立实例。它表示非单例实例，这可能对应于作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) 操作来显式检查独立实例。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate a singleton object. It indicates non-independent instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) operation to explicitly check for a shared singleton instance.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不明确表示单例对象。它表示非独立实例，这可能对应于作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) 操作来显式检查共享的单例实例。

items.source: NOTE: This method introspects top-level beans only. It does not check nested beans which might match the specified type as well. Also, it suppresses exceptions for beans that are currently in creation in a circular reference scenario: typically, references back to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 注意：此方法仅检查顶层 Bean。 它不会检查可能匹配指定类型的嵌套 Bean。此外，在循环引用场景中，它会**抑制正在创建中的 Bean 的异常：**通常是指向此方法调用者的引用。

items.source: If none specified, a default environment will be initialized via createEnvironment().
items.translation: 如果未指定，将通过 createEnvironment() 初始化默认环境。

items.source: Subclasses may override this method in order to supply a custom ConfigurableEnvironment implementation.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，以提供自定义的ConfigurableEnvironment实现。

items.source: Do not call this when needing to resolve a location pattern. Call the context's getResources method instead, which will delegate to the ResourcePatternResolver.
items.translation: 当需要解析位置模式时，请勿调用此方法。 请改用上下文的 getResources 方法，该方法将委托给 ResourcePatternResolver。

items.source: Uses SimpleApplicationEventMulticaster if none defined in the context.
items.translation: 若无在上下文中定义，则使用SimpleApplicationEventMulticaster。

items.source: Uses DefaultLifecycleProcessor if none defined in the context.
items.translation: 若无在上下文中定义的处理器，则使用DefaultLifecycleProcessor。

items.source: Invoked by all BeanFactory delegation methods that depend on an active context, i.e. in particular all bean accessor methods.
items.translation: 由所有依赖于活动上下文的 `BeanFactory` 委托方法调用，即特别是所有 Bean 访问器方法。

items.source: For matching a generic type, consider BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType).
items.translation: 对于匹配泛型类型，请考虑BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)。

items.source: Note that collections of beans are not supported here, in contrast to reflective injection points. For programmatically retrieving a list of beans matching a specific type, specify the actual bean type as an argument here and subsequently use ObjectProvider.orderedStream() or its lazy streaming/iteration options.
items.translation: 请注意，此处不支持集合形式的 Bean，这与反射注入点不同。若要程序化地检索与特定类型匹配的 Bean 列表，请将实际的 Bean 类型作为参数指定于此，随后使用ObjectProvider.orderedStream()或其懒式流/迭代选项。

items.source: All of those aliases point to the same bean when used in a BeanFactory.getBean(String) call.
items.translation: 所有这些别名在 `BeanFactory.getBean(String)` 调用中均指向同一个 bean。

items.source: This version of getBeanNamesForType matches all kinds of beans, be it singletons, prototypes, or FactoryBeans. In most implementations, the result will be the same as for getBeanNamesForType(type, true, true).
items.translation: 此版本的 `getBeanNamesForType` 匹配所有类型的 Bean，无论是单例、原型还是 FactoryBeans。在大多数实现中，结果与 `getBeanNamesForType(type, true, true)` 相同。

items.source: This is the internal delegate that all other publishEvent methods refer to. It is not meant to be called directly but rather serves as a propagation mechanism between application contexts in a hierarchy, potentially overridden in subclasses for a custom propagation arrangement.
items.translation: 这是所有其他 `publishEvent` 方法引用的内部委托。它不打算被直接调用，而是作为层次结构中应用程序上下文之间的传播机制，可能在子类中被重写以实现自定义的传播安排。

items.source: Uses parent's MessageSource if none defined in this context.
items.translation: 如果此上下文中未定义，则使用父级的MessageSource。

items.source: Delegates to doClose() for the actual closing procedure.
items.translation: 委托给doClose()执行实际的关闭过程。

items.source: Delegates to doClose() for the actual closing procedure. Also removes a JVM shutdown hook, if registered, as it's not needed anymore.
items.translation: 委托给doClose()执行实际的关闭过程。此外，如果已注册了 JVM 关闭钩子，也会将其移除，因为不再需要它。

items.source: Called by both close() and a JVM shutdown hook, if any.
items.translation: 由close()和（如果有的话）JVM 关闭钩子共同调用。

items.source: Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in. Use BeanFactoryUtils' beansOfTypeIncludingAncestors to include beans in ancestor factories too.
items.translation: 不考虑该工厂可能参与的任何层次结构。请使用 `BeanFactoryUtils` 的 `beansOfTypeIncludingAncestors` 方法，以包含祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source: The Map returned by this method should always return bean names and corresponding bean instances in the order of definition in the backend configuration, as far as possible.
items.translation: 此方法返回的 Map 应始终尽可能按照后端配置中定义顺序返回 Bean 名称及对应的 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Default is the object id of the context instance, or the name
of the context bean if the context is itself defined as a bean.
items.translation: 默认值为上下文实例的对象 ID，或者如果上下文本身被定义为 Bean，则为上下文 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Default is the object id of the context instance.
items.translation: 默认值为上下文实例的对象 ID。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses, for extended resolution strategies,
for example in a web environment.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写，以实现扩展的解析策略，例如在 Web 环境中。

items.source: Replace any stub property sources with actual instances.
items.translation: 将任何存根属性源替换为实际实例。

items.source:
This template method allows for registering special BeanPostProcessors
etc in certain AbstractApplicationContext subclasses.
items.translation: 此模板方法允许在特定的 AbstractApplicationContext 子类中注册特殊的 BeanPostProcessor 等。

items.source: Must be called before singleton instantiation.
items.translation: 必须在单例实例化之前调用。

items.source: Must be called before any instantiation of application beans.
items.translation: 必须在实例化任何应用程序 Bean 之前调用。

items.source:
Can be overridden to add context-specific bean destruction steps
right before or right after standard singleton destruction,
while the context's BeanFactory is still active.
items.translation: 可被重写以在标准单例销毁之前或之后、且上下文 BeanFactory 仍处于活动状态时，添加特定于上下文的 Bean 销毁步骤。

items.source:
Allows for specifying explicit constructor arguments / factory method arguments,
overriding the specified default arguments (if any) in the bean definition.
Note that the provided arguments need to match a specific candidate constructor /
factory method in the order of declared parameters.
items.translation: 允许指定显式的构造函数参数/工厂方法参数，覆盖 Bean 定义中指定的默认参数（如果有）。请注意，提供的参数必须按照声明参数的顺序与特定的候选构造函数/工厂方法相匹配。

items.source:
Note that this method considers objects created by FactoryBeans, which means
that FactoryBeans will get initialized in order to determine their object type.

items.source:

resource should be avoided, as far as possible. The result should
have set semantics.

items.source:

or return a single BeanFactory instance that it holds. In the latter case, it will
usually throw an IllegalStateException if refreshing the context more than once.

items.source:

returning the internal bean factory. The internal factory should generally be
considered unavailable once the context has been closed.

items.source: Is this bean a prototype? That is, will BeanFactory.getBean(String) always return independent instances?
items.translation: 这个 Bean 是原型吗？也就是说，BeanFactory.getBean(String) 是否总是返回独立的实例？

items.translation: 这个 Bean 是共享的单例吗？也就是说，BeanFactory.getBean(String) 是否总是返回同一个实例？

items.source: Remove the given ApplicationListener from this context's set of listeners, assuming it got registered via ConfigurableApplicationContext.addApplicationListener(ApplicationListener) before.
items.translation: 从此上下文的监听器集合中移除给定的 ApplicationListener，前提是它之前已通过ConfigurableApplicationContext.addApplicationListener(ApplicationListener)进行了注册。

items.source: Set the ApplicationStartup for this application context.
items.translation: 为此应用程序上下文设置ApplicationStartup。

items.source: The name of the MessageSource bean in the context. If none is supplied, message resolution is delegated to the parent.
items.translation: 上下文中的 `MessageSource` bean 的名称。 如果没有提供，消息解析将委托给父容器。

items.source: Cancel this context's refresh attempt, resetting the active flag after an exception got thrown.
items.translation: 取消此上下文的刷新尝试，在抛出异常后重置 `active` 标志。

items.source: Return the bean instances that match the given object type (including subclasses), judging from either bean definitions or the value of getObjectType in the case of FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 返回与给定对象类型（包括子类）匹配的 Bean 实例，判断依据是 Bean 定义或 FactoryBean 的 `getObjectType` 方法返回值。

items.source: Return the parent context, or null if there is no parent (that is, this context is the root of the context hierarchy).
items.translation: 返回父上下文，或者如果不存在父上下文（即此上下文是上下文层次结构的根），则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the parent bean factory, or null if there is none.
items.translation: 返回父 Bean 工厂，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Create a new AbstractApplicationContext with no parent.
items.translation: 创建一个没有父对象的新的 AbstractApplicationContext。

items.translation: 使用给定的父上下文创建一个新的 AbstractApplicationContext。

items.source: Clear all resource caches in this resource loader.
items.translation: 清除此资源加载器中的所有资源缓存。

items.source:
Finish the initialization of this context's bean factory,
initializing all remaining singleton beans.
items.translation: 完成此上下文的 Bean 工厂初始化，初始化所有剩余的单例 Bean。

items.source: Return the list of statically specified ApplicationListeners.
items.translation: 返回静态指定的 ApplicationListeners 列表。

items.source: Return a name for the deployed application that this context belongs to.
items.translation: 返回此上下文所属的已部署应用程序的名称。

items.source:
Return this context's internal bean factory as AutowireCapableBeanFactory,
if already available.
items.translation: 如果已可用，则返回此上下文的内部 Bean 工厂作为 AutowireCapableBeanFactory。

items.source:
Return the list of BeanFactoryPostProcessors that will get applied
to the internal BeanFactory.
items.translation: 返回将应用于内部 BeanFactory 的 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 列表。

items.source: Return a friendly name for this context.
items.translation: 为此上下文返回一个友好的名称。

items.source: Return the unique id of this application context.
items.translation: 返回此应用上下文的唯一 ID。

items.source:
Return the internal bean factory of the parent context if it implements
ConfigurableApplicationContext; else, return the parent context itself.
items.translation: 如果它实现了 ConfigurableApplicationContext，则返回父上下文的内部 BeanFactory；否则，返回父上下文本身。

items.source:
Return the internal message source of the parent context if it is an
AbstractApplicationContext too; else, return the parent context itself.
items.translation: 如果是 `AbstractApplicationContext`，则返回其父上下文的内部消息源；否则，直接返回父上下文本身。

items.source: Try to resolve the message.
items.translation: 尝试解决该消息。

items.source: Return the timestamp (ms) when this context was first loaded.
items.translation: 返回此上下文首次加载时的时间戳（毫秒）。

items.source: Determine the type of the bean with the given name.
items.translation: 确定给定名称的 Bean 的类型。

items.source:
Determine whether this application context is active, that is,
whether it has been refreshed at least once and has not been closed yet.
items.translation: 确定此应用程序上下文是否处于活动状态，即它是否至少刷新过一次且尚未关闭。

items.source: Check whether the bean with the given name matches the specified type.
items.translation: 检查给定名称的 Bean 是否与指定类型匹配。

items.source: Tell the subclass to refresh the internal bean factory.
items.translation: 告诉子类刷新内部 Bean 工厂。

items.source:
Configure the factory's standard context characteristics,
such as the context's ClassLoader and post-processors.
items.translation: 配置工厂的标准上下文特性，例如上下文的 ClassLoader 和后置处理器。

items.source:
Prepare this context for refreshing, setting its startup date and
active flag as well as performing any initialization of property sources.
items.translation: 准备此上下文以进行刷新，设置其启动日期和激活标志，以及执行任何属性源的初始化。

items.source: Return information about this context.
items.translation: 返回有关此上下文的信息。

items.source: Logger used by this class. Available to subclasses.
items.translation: 本类使用的 Logger。可供子类使用。

items.source:

items.translation: 添加实现 `ApplicationListener` 的 Bean 作为监听器。这不会影响其他监听器，这些监听器可以以非 Bean 的方式添加。

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether stream access may introspect lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans - or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference - for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references. Only actually necessary initialization for type checking purposes will be performed; constructor and method invocations will still be avoided as far as possible.
